meta.name: Alkahest Calcite Achievement Seal
meta.description: An unlockable trophy seal of The Sovereign Ward-Breakers of the Obsidian Seal. Sworn to cracking the 1% strict-locked Obsidian Hazard seals via 8-perimeter equal-depth catalyst detonations. This magical trinket, socketed or carried, reveals depth contours on newly exposed strata for deep excavation. Crafted from Alkahest Calcite.
